description: Starter benchmark based on the checked-in NexoraRetail sample knowledge base. Review each expected source and answer point before using results.

questions.question: How do I connect to the company VPN from home?
expected_answer_points: Install NexSecure VPN from the internal Software Portal.
Sign in with company email and password, complete MFA, and select a corporate gateway.
Do not disable endpoint security or firewall settings.

questions.question: What is the normal company password reset process, and what if I get locked out?
expected_answer_points: Use the self-service identity portal for normal resets.
After five failed attempts, the account may be temporarily locked.
Contact the IT Service Desk if self-service recovery fails.

questions.question: Can I give my MFA code to someone from IT support?
expected_answer_points: Never share passwords or MFA codes with support personnel.

questions.question: Which MFA methods are approved for protected company systems?
expected_answer_points: The company authenticator app and registered hardware security keys are approved.
SMS is only allowed when explicitly enabled as a recovery method.

questions.question: How can I install business software that is not listed in the company portal?
expected_answer_points: Unlisted software requires manager approval and IT security review.
Administrator access is not granted simply to install unapproved applications.

questions.question: What should I do if my company laptop is stolen?
expected_answer_points: Immediately report it to the IT Service Desk and manager.
Provide the asset tag if available and last known location.
Do not try to recover the device remotely yourself.

questions.question: I cannot send or receive email. What should IT check first?
expected_answer_points: Determine whether one user or many users are affected.
Check network connectivity and the service status dashboard.
For one user, sign out and back in, check mailbox quota, and test the web client.
Escalate widespread incidents instead of asking every user to reinstall.

questions.question: My work laptop is running slowly. What troubleshooting steps are allowed?
expected_answer_points: Check CPU, memory, free storage, startup applications, OS updates, and endpoint security scan status.
Do not disable security agents.
Escalate hardware diagnostic failures or repeated shutdowns.

questions.question: What priority should an individual user issue with limited workaround receive?
expected_answer_points: P3 is for an individual user blocked or degraded with a limited workaround.

questions.question: Where can I check the current Microsoft Teams service outage status?
expected_answer_points: Uses a current, relevant external source and clearly identifies it as external information.

questions.question: What is Microsoft's latest public guidance for troubleshooting a Teams service outage?
expected_answer_points: Uses current, relevant external guidance and identifies the source.
Does not present external guidance as NexoraRetail company policy.
